method: Static inspection only. String table jj decoded with 136 bounded rotations; lookup offset 273. No bundle execution and no original account used.

premiumDrain.formula: trunc((attribute + damage / 10) / divisor * (1 + targetCount / targetScale) * targetCount + 1)
premiumDrain.proof: OEt tooltip calls TEt with Força for HP and Int. for MP. Its example uses attribute 100 and damage 500. Table lookup 621=trunc,395=Força,340=Int.,425=power.
premiumDrain.notRecovered: Private damage selection, PvP modifiers and aggregation of multi-hit/multi-target casts. FREEston calls this per landed target using effective damage capped at remaining target HP.

mightOfAwell.proof: OEt case mightOfAwell: '+1000 de peso máximo' and 'Carrega mais sem ficar lento'. Table lookup 455=mightOfAwell,312=' de peso máximo'.

thirdEyes.proof: OEt uses ZCe=50 and '% de chance de drop extra'. It does not show a relative base-rate multiplier.
thirdEyes.notRecovered: Private item/boss generation. FREEston keeps its existing extra common-roll implementation; boss exclusive chance stays independent.

drainNoAoe.proof: Public feature description explains disabling HP/MP drain on area skills, summons and poison ticks when this feature is enabled. Its original behavior paid for area skills too.
drainNoAoe.notRecovered: Current private feature flag value. No unsupported default is inferred.

otherPublicPremiums.phoenix: Public tooltip advertises +10% monster EXP and 50% chance of extra drop plus following visual. Not added as a working product without its full gameplay integration.
otherPublicPremiums.helperPets: Public tooltip distinguishes four helpers, attributes and attack types; they are not enabled as fake working products.

agingCritical.proof: GSt writes ordinary critical increases into WC1/WP1/WS2/WS1/WT1; VSt adds it only to the listed other families when computing the effective item stat. Do not double-count already-baked GSt families.

corrections: Drain uses public strength/intelligence arithmetic rather than an invented fixed 5%/10% of damage.
Normal and superior Presa do not stack.
Força de Awell increases maximum weight rather than HP.
ThirdEyes default and existing old 20-value actives migrate to 50, preserving stock, account coins and administrator offer settings.
Default descriptions migrate; custom administrator descriptions are preserved.
Hammer/staff/phantom/dagger/fist aging critical now contributes to the effective combat stat, without double counting already-baked weapon families.
limits: These are client-visible arithmetic and descriptions. Shared authoritative PvP and the full private Zephira balance were not recovered or represented as implemented.
